<b>Underlofts</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are sickly [[Underworkers]], bearing two twistpins that were once tools of repair but now serve as spun projectiles.<ref>Underloft [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Exhausted bug, grown sickly from the smog of the Underworks. The worker's twistpins, once tools of repair, now serve as spun projectiles."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Underlofts often cling to walls and other surfaces as they work, but jump off to attack Hornet once she gets near.<br>
Being flying enemies, they try to remain aerially out of range of Hornet's [[Needle]], and fly back and forth with poor control, preferring horizontal distance over vertical distance. They use one of two attacks depending on Hornet's range from them:
* <b>Twistpin Throw:</b> Readies and then hurls a spinning projectile at Hornet, which flies in a straight path, dealing {{Damage|1}}. It can be hit with a Needle to disable its hitbox.
* <b>Cartwheel:</b> If Hornet is very close to or anywhere beneath them, it holds out both its twistpins and begins spinning rapidly, rearing back briefly before flying at Hornet as it spins, bouncing off a surface once before stopping a second after. If Hornet is hit at any part of the attack, it deals {{Damage|1+1}}.

Underlofts deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

Chasing them down and maintaining pressure is key to defeating them, as well as retreating or dashing away briefly whenever they use Cartwheel, due to its threatening hitbox and damage.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Underlofts have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|

* These halls kept clean...
* Rest and fade...
* We... were chosen...
* See us faithful!
* Shells bend, shells break...
* Through duty, purity...
* The sacred toil...
}}

== Location ==
Underlofts can be found primarily in the [[Underworks]], with one encountered as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the northwest of the area, three in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 2|gauntlet]] in the middle of the area, and another during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 3|gauntlet]] in [[the Cauldron]].

In [[Act 3]], a [[black-threaded]] Underloft is fought during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 2|gauntlet]] in the ruined [[Cogwork Core]], and another spawns alongside a [[Void Mass]] in the Cauldron.
